description: This file defines the 'Snoopy' class, a PHP-based web client library used for fetching web pages over HTTP and HTTPS. It includes methods for performing HTTP requests, handling redirects, parsing HTML content, managing cookies, and supporting gzip compression. The class is designed to facilitate programmatic web requests within PHP applications.

classes.name: Snoopy
classes.description: A PHP class providing methods to fetch web pages, handle HTTP/HTTPS requests, manage cookies, and parse HTML content.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Fetches the contents of a web page or resource specified by the URI.

methods.name: _httprequest
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request with specified headers, method, and body.

methods.name: _httpsrequest
methods.description: Performs an HTTPS request using cURL.

methods.name: setcookies
methods.description: Extracts and sets cookies from response headers.

methods.name: _check_timeout
methods.description: Checks whether a socket read operation has timed out.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a socket connection to the server or proxy.

methods.name: _prepare_post_body
methods.description: Prepares POST request body based on encoding type.
